title: registry.extended
description: Emitted by the write_schema agent tool after a new entry is written to the customer's per-customer registry DDB (origin='extension'). Operator agent subscribes to detect cross-customer agreement patterns and decide when to promote into the canonical baseline.

schema_version.description: Bumped on breaking shape change. Consumers branch on it.

openly_operated.description: Set at emit time from local SSM tenant metadata. Defaults to false at the tool level for these — they're operator-internal signals, not public-facing platform events. Customer can opt them in via tenant config if they want their schema-evolution history visible in the public archive.

customer_id.description: Tenant identifier. Same as envelope account-id but saves operator agent a join when clustering.

registry.description: Which canonical registry the extension belongs to. Enum grows as new registry-bearing modules ship.

name.description: The new entry's identifier within the bucket. UPPER_SNAKE for chart_of_accounts (e.g., TIPS_REVENUE); snake_case for fields registries (e.g., loyalty_tier).

schema.description: Registry-specific shape value. chart_of_accounts: just true (the bucket+name presence IS the schema). contact_fields/calendar_fields: object with {type, required, description, [enum/values/default/...] } matching the canonical JSON shape. Validated by the consuming module's validator at runtime; flexible at the event layer.

reason.description: Free-form, captured for operator agent's promotion review. Why this customer needed this entry — clusters by reason text are a strong promotion signal alongside same registry+bucket+name.

created_by.description: Provenance: 'agent_session' | 'owner_direct' | 'imported'. Defaults to 'agent_session'. Helps operator agent distinguish agent-inferred extensions from explicit owner asks (latter is a stronger promotion signal).
